## extends

A subclass inherits fields/methods and can `@Override` behavior. Every class ultimately extends `Object`.

## Polymorphism

A variable of the parent type can hold a subclass instance; the actual method called is chosen at runtime (dynamic dispatch).

## final and abstract

`final` prevents overriding/subclassing. `abstract` classes cannot be instantiated and may declare methods without bodies.

Prefer **composition over inheritance** when the relationship is not a true "is-a".
